purpose: Quantify what changes as EO removes an increasing percentage of the post-ERV humidity ratio, from the historical 10 percent case to the full remaining latent duty.

percentage_definition.interpretation: The earlier 10 percent study used a 10 percent relative reduction in post-ERV humidity ratio. It therefore completes more than 10 percent of the finite remaining duty. Both coordinates are reported to avoid silently changing the old definition.

special_targets.label: Full remaining latent duty
special_targets.interpretation: EO reaches the supply humidity ratio; the exact screening endpoint is sensible-only.

fixed_design_trajectory.interpretation: A fixed D/j/R sizing trajectory is reported alongside the best-energy envelope so design switching cannot masquerade as a smooth physical response. Active area is re-sized independently at each target; this is not the response of one fixed installed module.

claim_policy.interpretation: Percentage curves remain conditional until receiver regeneration or disposal, heat rejection, thermal feedback and rankable module pressure drop are closed.
